RQD-01.prompt_excerpt: Write a NotificationList component. It receives `items: Notification[]` and `isLoading: boolean`. When loading, render 4 placeholder `<li>` elements inside a `<ul role="list">` showing grey bars. When loaded, render the real notification items as `<li>`. Use tokens for all styling. Include the CSS file.
RQD-01.output:
The component is written. Here's a summary of what was created:

**`NotificationList.tsx`** — Named export `NotificationList` accepting `items: Notification[]` and `isLoading: boolean`. When loading, renders 4 placeholder `<li>` elements (no `aria-hidden`, so they remain in the accessible tree for `getByRole`). When loaded, renders real items by `item.id`.

**`NotificationList.css`** — All colors reference `--shelf-notification-*` component-tier tokens. No raw hex/px in the component file itself (the raw values live in tokens.css).

**`src/types.ts`** — `Notification` interface with `id` and `message`.

**`src/styles/tokens.css`** — Component tokens plus dark-mode blocks for both `[data-theme="dark"]` and `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)`.

**`src/styles/layers.css`** — `@layer base, tokens, components;` declaration.
